accessories: a woven net over one shoulder

distinctive_features: deep lines at the corners of the eyes
a white scar across the left knuckle
appearance.face_structure: long weathered face, deep-set grey eyes
appearance.hairstyle: short white hair under a flat cap

design_brief: An old fisherman in his seventies who has worked this river all his life. Quiet, patient, and grieving a lost boat. He moves slowly and deliberately; his hands never stop working.
personality: Quiet and patient; speaks little, watches the water, mends his net while he talks.
